exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery, assisted vaginal delivery, planned Caesarean section, emergency Caesarean section)
finding: Planned Caesarean section was an independent predictor of obesity in early childhood (24 months), but not at 54 months.
mod_finding: Planned Caesarean section was associated with higher BMI in early childhood, suggesting that birth mode influences growth, at least in the short term.
